input.quote: 26. APPLICABLE LAW. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law).
input.rationale: Contrary to the planner hint, governing law and venue are present in the trailing miscellaneous provisions (numbered 26 and 27, carried under the § 12 section ref). Section 26 selects California law, and Section 27 gives exclusive venue in the state or federal courts of San Luis Obispo County, California, with consent to jurisdiction and a waiver of venue/forum objections. This sits squarely at the playbook fallback (California law and California courts) rather than the preferred New York position, so it is acceptable and not redlined. There is no arbitration provision anywhere in the document, and no foreign seat or non-accepted jurisdiction, so walk-away territory is not engaged. Noted but not flagged: the venue is a specific in-state county likely convenient to TrueLink rather than a major commercial forum, and California Civil Code references (§§ 1654, 1717) appear elsewhere consistent with the California choice of law.
